e0fdbe92033753f4.title: Lipid elongation as a hallmark of aging
digest: Li and colleagues identify lipid acyl chain elongation as a conserved hallmark of aging across tissues and species.
Genetic shortening of lipid chains extends lifespan in worms, which establishes chain length as a causal contributor to aging.

7e2413261f699c0a.title: Longer lipids mark aging and constrain lifespan
digest: Investigating age-related remodeling of lipid species to shed light on the molecular underpinnings of aging, here Li et al.
show that lipid acyl chains become longer with age.

9137db683413d84e.title: Decline of chaperone-mediated autophagy in aging impairs macrophage clearance of senescent cells
digest: This study looks at how the decline in chaperone-mediated autophagy in aging alters senescent cell properties leading to an impairment in their immune clearance.
Utilizing proteomic and metabolomic analyses, the authors show that restoring autophagy enhances macrophage function and reduces senescent cell accumulation.

a41aee4b798f358d.title: Design and model choices shape inference of age-varying genetic effects on complex traits
digest: Genetic influences on complex traits change over the lifespan.
show that cross-sectional and longitudinal studies can give different estimates of how genetic effects change with age, mainly owing to birth cohort differences and participation bias.

5b3768662a723e1c.title: High-throughput metabolic engineering in mammalian cells
digest: Engineering complex phenotypes into mammalian cells holds profound potential but remains a largely intractable engineering challenge.
We developed shotgun genetic engineering (SGE), a multiplexed strategy that screens millions of combinatorial solutions in a single experiment.

7e3e7fcf17146f37.title: Longitudinal multiomics reveals personalized aging trajectories
digest: Longitudinal multiomics reveals personalized aging trajectories

f030eb9411dd0859.title: What are hospital longevity programs, and what can they tell you about your health?
digest: For patients willing to pay thousands of dollars out of pocket, prestigious hospitals across the country are offering a new speciality: longevity.
Cash-pay longevity clinics promise to monitor all sorts of health indicators and provide guidance on how to live a longer, healthier life.

99ef20c3ab045d81.title: Scientist, Computational Biology
digest: About Arc Institute Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases.
Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.
